patch.description: Requires a current Connector access bearer token. Edits only a bound device owned by that account; empty remark clears it. Trimmed remark is limited to 100 Unicode characters and 256 UTF-8 bytes.

200.description: v2 envelope with data.device_id and canonical data.remark

404.description: No matching bound device owned by the account

delete.description: Requires a current Connector access bearer token. Unbinds another device owned by the account, clears its remark and revokes its sessions and routes. The calling device cannot unbind itself through this endpoint.

200.description: v2 envelope with data.device_id and data.deleted=true

404.description: No matching bound device owned by the account

409.description: Calling device cannot be unbound here

parameters.name: use_password
parameters.description: Value 1 explicitly selects another account for a pending Connector transaction. The same-tab login form binds that transaction and shows a login-and-authorize action. GET never approves a device; successful explicit submission redirects directly to account.

200.description: Trusted escaped HTML consent form with browser binding cookie; no authentication is completed

303.description: Missing browser account or explicit account switch: enter contextual account login. Confirmation and login-and-authorize both return directly to account.

post.description: Requires exact configured Origin, Secure host-only browser cookie, matching csrf and explicit user approval. Global persists state/nonce/PKCE before redirect. No browser-selected redirect URI.

303.description: Redirect to fixed IdP authorization endpoint

get.description: Fixed registered callback. One-time state plus browser binding checked before code exchange. Global checks RS256, fixed issuer/audience/azp/nonce/expiry using trusted JWKS and maps issuer/subject to existing account authority. Failed/uncertain exchange requires new login; no authentication token in redirect or logs.

303.description: Redirect to trusted completion page without query parameters

503.description: IdP/authority unavailable; transaction not guessed successful

401.description: Invalid signed identity claims; no local authorization issued

303.description: Compatibility alias redirects to account; no intermediate completion page
